about: Config keys the platform writes into $KIROCREW_HOME/config.json that KiroCrew reads (sections: dataclass fields of KiroCrewConfig and its section configs). tests/test_kirocrew_contract.py keeps seed() inside this list; tests/native checks the list against the installed KiroCrew on every deploy. runtime_errors: the words of KiroCrew's runtime failures the platform retries on its own (octopus/engine.py transient), each with a failure as EC2 reported it; tests/native checks the installed KiroCrew still contains each phrase.
